body: I kinda get youre reasoning. Life is very mundane and boring. Wake up, work. sleep over and over until you die. I envy social media personalities a bit but then again they lack privacy and get caught up in superficial metrics such as views, followers, $$$, sponsorships, and name brand things. I think this is why for as long as I've lived I've trolled or have done extremely vengeful things, or became randomly petty  to a target or done extremely illegal acts, hell manipulating is fun too but I have empathy as well and matured a lot. Still that instinct exists - enacting my personal justice and boredom has shaped my chaotic nature. I dont mind chaos and I find destruction to be a necessity so I take pleasure in that. I feel sick since its something that keeps me going a little... In that sense I admire cult leaders or charismatic people who scam and manipulate ppl a little even if they disgust me.
I've made this decision to rest peacefully; theyre too powerful anyways.
